card.title: PS4 Power Stage Drivers Measurement (Vgpu, Vmem, Vcpu) — FDMF6840C

claims.statement: Remove coils one at a time to see which mosfet is shorted on the Vgpu power stage driver because all of them are connected in parallel.
claims.evidence: Vgpu power stage driver circuit structure uses parallel connected mosfets.
claims.quote: Remove coils one at a time to see which mosfet is shorted. (parallel circuit) Because all of them are parallel connected

claims.statement: The impedance of RAM is 56 ohm and Vram is 1,5V.
claims.evidence: Impedance and voltage measurement on Vmem power stage driver.

claims.statement: The impedance of CPU is 19 ohm and Vcpu is 0,96V.
claims.evidence: Impedance and voltage measurement on Vcpu power stage driver.

claims.statement: If +12V is shorted, you can lift the main coil filter to narrow the shorted area.
claims.evidence: Main coil filter connection to +12V power supply.
claims.quote: If +12V is shorted, you can lift this coil to narrow shorted area

procedure: Remove coils one at a time on the Vgpu power stage driver to isolate a shorted MOSFET in the parallel circuit.
Lift the main coil filter to narrow the shorted area if +12V is shorted.
card.caveats: Ensure proper board identification as PS4 mainboard revisions vary (SAA, SAB, SAC, SAE, SAF).
